$schemaComment: Canonical Scenario.com MCP workspace for Containment Protocol visual production. Agents: read before Scenario MCP calls. Never invent team_id or project_id.

mcp.note: toolsets=full lists the full catalog as first-class tools (~90+; ~64 are catalog-only on the lean URL and otherwise need scenario_tool_execute_read/write/delete).

sourceOfTruth.scenarioRole: Visual production — concept art, environments, characters, props, UI mock studies, reference library
sourceOfTruth.runtime: Never wire Scenario SDK/OAuth into src/ or CI

costPolicy: Do not run expensive batches, video, or training without an approved plan and cost estimate (align with Scenario project/user instructions).
accessNote: Ids are Scenario URL segments, not API secrets. Access is gated by Scenario OAuth (Cursor MCP) or team API key.
